capabilities: Export the current note, a folder, or selected notes to a .chm file
Build the table of contents from heading hierarchy, folder structure, or a flat list
Generate a keyword index from headings, frontmatter and inline tags, and aliases
Rewrite internal links to exported pages and embed referenced attachments
Detect and run the HTML Help Workshop compiler (hhc.exe) from a staged temp directory
extras: Windows only (desktop-only plugin). HTML Help Workshop is no longer distributed by Microsoft; the README points to the Internet Archive copy (with MD5 and Authenticode checks) or Chocolatey. Not in the community catalogue, so it is installed manually from release files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to package notes and their attachments into a self-contained offline CHM documentation file with a table of contents, index and search.

relations.evidence: it needs HTML Help Workshop — Microsoft's CHM compiler (hhc.exe)

summary: Export plugin that compiles one or many notes, with attachments, into a single offline Compiled HTML Help (.chm) file.
